label: Alternative episodes separate source cuts from occurrence coverage
paraphrase: One stipulated Boolean circuit has two alternative contributor episodes borne by the same source, a separate receptive enabler and one effect token. Either episode with the enabler supplies an available record, while omitting the enabler does not. The common source has a populated cut, the enabler bearer does not, and assigning the second episode to a different source defeats the original cut. A second dictionary retains a populated cut at the all-on actual scenario while its effect also occurs with all source inputs absent; occurrence coverage fails. Record semantics only, not actual conservation or a complete inertial worldview.
